starting_militia_units_in_gravity_well.description: Hostile militia garrison spawned in the home gravity well at galaxy generation. Only applied when the home planet starts unowned. A unit whose primary ship_role is bomb_planet will disable the owning player's colonize auto-cast.

starting_militia_units_owner.description: Npc player definition that owns starting_militia_units_in_gravity_well. Leave unset to use a random militia player.

starting_militia_units_supply.description: Supply budget for starting_militia_units_in_gravity_well random_units. required_units always spawn regardless.

starting_player_inventory_items.description: Items to add to player's inventory at game start
